title: His wives, the shooting and the Bible
summary: Who his first wife was, the book not being scripture, and a Bible joke.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Sure, right, buy the book. I recommend it entirely, called Beneath the Underdog by Charles Mingus, Jr. Did you ever see -- your first wife was named Barbara, wasn't it?
No, I know, it was your high school girlfriend. Your second wife was Barbara.
My first wife was Jean. The book is not supposed to tell you what it is. I don't want to (inaudible) involve anybody in my private life.
Mary Ellen was my first wife. We had no children.
Her father shot you in the shoulder.
Well, the book is not the Bible.
The Bible ain't the Bible, sometimes.
The Bible, yeah, they got some fantastic stories --
Cats walking on water and all that.
No, another cat got out of the boat and tried, maybe a few steps. Paul?
Oh, and he lost faith and sank.
You're bringing it all back to me. I'd forgotten all that. All my Sunday School lessons.
